description: This file declares function prototypes and includes necessary headers for the CRC firmware library for the STM32F10x microcontroller series. It is part of the hardware abstraction layer providing CRC-related functionalities.

methods.name: CRC_ResetDR
methods.description: Resets the CRC Data Register to its initial state.

methods.name: CRC_CalcCRC
methods.description: Calculates the CRC for a 32-bit data word.

methods.name: CRC_CalcBlockCRC
methods.description: Calculates the CRC for a buffer of data words.

methods.name: CRC_GetCRC
methods.description: Returns the current value of the CRC calculation.

methods.name: CRC_SetIDRegister
methods.description: Sets the ID register with a specified value.

methods.name: CRC_GetIDRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the ID register.
